purpose: Teach: アングル/ブラザー/キャリー/ストリング/ブックス/アンバランス/ワンポイント/ダート

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「写真のアングルを変えてみよう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad mentioned trying a different angle for your photos.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Sharing something gentle she overheard. Soft opening, unhurried pacing. The tenderness of passing along a parent's small encouragement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとブラザーのプリンターを設定したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I set up the printer together.
lines.style: Bright, proud delivery. Quick-paced excitement, but genuine rather than performed. The pleasure of accomplishment, not of showing off. Small, authentic brightness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「キャリーって映画は怖いから子供は早いね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad said Carrie is too scary for you right now.
lines.style: Gentle protectiveness in the phrasing. Soft, matter-of-fact tone — not warning, just relaying. Slight warmth underneath, the caring of someone who listens to what fathers say.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとギターのストリング、つまり弦を張り替えたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I replaced the guitar strings today.
lines.style: Earnest and steady. Pride in the competence, not boastfulness. Slight emphasis on the accomplishment without needing approval. The quiet confidence of a child who's been trusted with something real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとブックス、つまり大型書店に行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad took me to the big bookstore.
lines.style: Reflective, sharing a small memory. Quiet, unhurried pace. The tone of someone recalling something peaceful that happened. No rush to make it impressive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「アンバランスな絵も個性」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me that unbalanced drawings have their own style too.
lines.style: Thoughtful, treasuring the lesson. Slow, careful delivery — the weight of something a parent said that mattered. Slight trailing-off, as if still turning it over in his mind.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがワンポイントの刺繍ハンカチを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad gave me an embroidered handkerchief with a small design.
lines.style: Tenderness and reverence for the small gift. Soft, almost delicate pacing. The voice of someone holding something precious. Quiet wonder that something so small can mean so much.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと競馬のダートレース観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched the horse races with Dad on the dirt track.
lines.style: Warm, eager but genuine. Bright eyes in the voice without loudness. The uncomplicated joy of sharing an experience with someone he trusts. Closes with natural, contented finality.
